edges.rationale: dispatch takes the next ready task from the queue; the call is on the first path through the method body.
dispatch returns unfinished work to the queue before returning; the call is on a field receiver, so a syntactic extractor sees a possible-dispatch rather than a resolved edge.

shutdown must drain the queue before the scheduler can be dropped. No static call site exists: the queue is reached through a trait object installed at construction, so no candidate source in this pipeline can see it. This is the edge the omission metric exists for.
